name: Athira PT
title: AI Engineer | Deep Learning | CV | LLM | Agentic AI
tagline: Building scalable AI systems for real-world intelligence.
about:
I am an AI Engineer and M.Tech graduate from IIT Madras with a strong foundation in deep learning, machine learning, and scalable AI systems.

I am deeply interested in Deep Learning and Generative AI, and passionate about building and deploying production-grade AI solutions across Computer Vision, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic AI systems.

My long-term goal is to pursue a PhD and contribute to research in advanced AI systems that bridge theory and real-world deployment.

highlights: Developed a prompt-driven LLM backend using FastAPI and Gemma-3-4B-IT.
Designed a natural-language property search query parser and custom LLM generation engine with context and KV cache management.
Built a multimodal similarity search system using Google Vertex AI and pgvector.
Implemented Edge Functions (Supabase) for asynchronous embedding workflows.
Provided SPI driver support for MSPM0 devices (A/B/C silicon bring-up).
Handled N1 silicon bring-up, clocks, and power domains.
Developed C-based HAL functions for peripherals like PMIC and GPIO.
Built a knowledge base construction model with multi-task learning from PDF documents (F1 score: 0.77).
Developed a Real-time Occupancy Monitoring System using centroid tracking and background subtraction.

projects.name: CPU vs GPU Performance Analysis
projects.description: A benchmarking study comparing CPU and GPU performance for training a from scratch Feed-Forward Neural Network (FNN) on the MNIST handwritten digit classification dataset. Six gradient-descent optimization algorithms are implemented from scratch—each with a CPU-only and a CUDA GPU-accelerated version—and evaluated across two network sizes.
